name: OSM Bar
ingredients: Ingredients: Rolled oats 27%, Dried apricots 12% (contains sulphites), Manuka honey blend (Manuka 5%, Honeydew), Maltodextrin, Rice bran oil, Soy protein isolate, Rice Flour, Humectant (glycerin), Wheat flakes 4% (contains wheat, barley), Raisins 3%, Coconut oil, Maize starch, Vegetable gum (acacia gum), Natural flavours, Salt, Vitamins & Minerals (Calcium, Vitamin C, Magnesium, Zinc, Vitamin A, Vitamin D, Iodine, Niacin, Vitamin B2, Folate), Caramelised sugar syrup, Emulsifier (soy lecithin).
storage: Store in a cool, dry place or freeze until use.
note: MAY CONTAIN PEANUT — the label's 'May be present' line names Peanut. Only the back panel was photographed, so no flavour/variant name is available; do not assume one. pack.size 516 g and count 6 are DERIVED from the printed 'SERVINGS PER PACKAGE: THREE' x 'AVERAGE SERVING SIZE: 172g (2 BARS)' — the net weight is not on the panel photographed. Trans fat is printed as '<0.1g' per serving and per 100 g, which is not a number, so fatTrans is omitted. Label also carries: 'CAUTION: While care has been taken to remove apricot kernel and fragments, some may remain.' and 'OSM is a formulated meal replacement - not to be used as a total diet replacement.'
